gizmo.title: Taịlụ ọnụọgụ
gizmo.description: Otu ọnụọgụ dị mkpa, nwere akara aha ya na otu o si gbanwee. Tinye ọtụtụ n'ime grid maka ahịrị dashboard.

configure.title: Uru

configure.title: Mgbanwe

configure.title: Ntụzịaka
